// @path: src/app/ops/api/route.ts
// @expect: OPS-REQUIRE-OPERATOR
// `export { handler as GET }` makes handler a route entry point just as surely
// as `export function GET`, and the guard scan only looked for the word export
// in front of a function.
import { listSchoolsForOps } from "@/lib/ops/reads";

async function handler() {
  return Response.json(await listSchoolsForOps());
}

export { handler as GET };
